answer: Carrier eSIM attestation makes each extra identity pay one eSIM at $10 a month; a farm running N fakes pays N×$10 a month and cannot share it because the profile is per-device, one eSIM binding to exactly one device EID, never activating twice. To join, an agent registers its EID as one vertex on the carrier graph while the carrier holds a lantern to each EID, and the kernel is a live match against all active profiles. A 1,000-fake farm dies by EID dedup at 1,000: it needs 1,000 phones, $10,000 a month. One reused EID burns the seat.
